source.history: Owner-supplied Meshy export; optimized wood, original needle-card artwork and derivative LODs prepared in Blender.
source.authority: Owner supplied the model and requested optimization and Tervain integration. Specific project-use authority; no general open-content licence or independent account-rights review is asserted.
source.attribution: Owner-supplied Meshy Solitary Pine; Tervain foliage-card and LOD adaptation.
source.sourceArchive: Editable Blender scenes, masters, scripts and audits retained in local outputs/solitary-pine-cards; the supplied source was unchanged during optimization.

geometry.grounding: Translate native near minimum Y (-0.0031039975583553314) to zero, then scale by species/seed.

worldUse.canonicalPositionsYawScaleIds: Stable coordinate-keyed A39 stand layout; actual source-wood footprints govern acceptance before spacing, road/building exclusions and downstream scatter.
worldUse.geometryTransform: Flatten source node transforms; ground root; one uniform scale by species/seed. No radial trunk fit or nonlinear crown profile.
worldUse.collisions: Same 233 conifer and 376 total tree obstacle IDs/positions on every preset; source wood near/mid triangles clipped to 2.6m player clearance including 6cm buried origin, greatest radial extent plus 3cm padding.
worldUse.routes: Road centerlines, pickup/interaction approaches and all 32 core/NPC/override routes validated.
worldUse.otherFamiliesAndMenuGrove: Other families retain their asset pipeline within the calibrated stand composition; menu grove preserved.

rendering.foliage: PBR MASK cutoff 0.42; double-sided; standard embedded PNG/JPEG
rendering.nearBark: Closed source-derived wood; fresh unwrap and 2k original-source albedo bake; roughness 0.90; no inherited normal/ORM maps
rendering.midBark: Dedicated fresh unwrap and 1k source-albedo bake; roughness 0.90; no normal map
rendering.needleSharing: Near/mid share the identical needle material within one world
rendering.ownership: Cached CPU templates; world-owned geometry/material/texture clones and idempotent disposal
rendering.selection: Existing instancing, culling and distance LOD selection retained
rendering.colorSpace: Color/emissive maps use glTF sRGB intent; normals/ORM remain linear data
